explanation_text: The current coil carries a current of [latex]I +I_P[/latex] and produces a filed corresponding to this current. Hence the error caused by the pressure coil current flowing in the current coil is neutralized.

and [latex] H(s)=1 [/latex]

[latex]\Rightarrow \;\; 1+\frac{k\left ( s+\frac{2}{3} \right )}{s^2(s+2)}=0 [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\; s^3+2s^2+k\left ( s+\frac{2}{3} \right )=0 [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\; s^3+2s^2+ks+\frac{2k}{3}=0[/latex]
Routh array:

As [latex]k \gt 0[/latex], there is no sign change in the 1st column of routh array. So the system is stable and all the three roots lie on LHS of s-plane.
For [latex]k \gt 0(k\neq 0)[/latex], none of the row of Routh array becomes zero. So root loci does not cross the [latex]j\omega[/latex]-axis.

Number of poles= P =3
Number of branches terminating at infinity = P-Z = 3-1 =2
Angle of asymptotes [latex]=\frac{(2k+1) \times 180^{\circ}}{P-Z} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;\;=\frac{(2k+1) \times 180^{\circ}}{2} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;\;=(2k+1) \times 90^{\circ} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;\;=90^{\circ} \; and \; 270^{\circ}[/latex]
[latex] Centroid=\frac{\Sigma poles-\Sigma zero}{P-Z} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;=\frac{0+0-2-\left ( -\frac{2}{3} \right )}{2}=-\frac{2}{3}[/latex]

Since, all the three branches terminates at [latex]R_e(s)=-\frac{2}{3}[/latex]. So, all the three roots have nearly equal real parts.
